name: Yoshinari Hibiki
source: True to her cool appearance, she is a taciturn teacher who is feared by the students. She is the head of the first-year grade level and is also in charge of student discipline. Having grown up in a family that runs a traditional martial arts dojo, she became an inflexible person who values adherence to rules above all else, binding the students tightly with strict regulations.
